{{Quote|The facility is primarily used for weapons research and hidden, for the most part, from the prying eyes of Imperial General Otto.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Moore]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwSMA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Sergeant Moore, again|Lok}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Research Facility''' was a weapon research center established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The base is responsible for manufacturing high-grade explosives for the Empire, including grenades. But like I mentioned, there is no obvious Imperial presence at the base. No Imperial soldiers, no guards. The entire base is staffed by trigger happy freelance mercenaries and Droidekas.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Moore]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwSMA" />}}
The Imperial Research Facility was operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the development and the production of new weapons.<ref name="SWG:SwSMA" /> Numerous scientists specialized in different areas, including explosives, chemicals and gasses, worked in the facility. There, they developed various research projects for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] such as new ranged weapons, explosives and even [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]].<ref name="SWG:QS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Question Scientists|Lok}}</ref>

The Imperial Research Facility was associated to a secret [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial Mine]] also located on Lok. The minerals and gasses mined were used by the Empire at the research facility.<ref name="SWG:SwSM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Sergeant Moore|Lok}}</ref> Because of a feud between [[General/Legends|General]] [[Otto]], the commander of the [[Imperial Outpost (Lok)|Imperial garrison]] on Lok, and Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in charge of the mine and research facility, there was very little Imperial presence at the research facility. In order to prevent General Otto from meddling in their affairs, these officers deployed [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to guard the mine and the research facility instead of requisitioning Otto's troops.<ref name="SWG:SwSMA" />

==History==
{{Quote|There's an Imperial research facility on Lok that our spies think is filled with experimental weapons. Nym wants whatever that base is building.|[[Kole]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Kole|Lok}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the scientists of the Imperial Research Facility worked on several projects, including a novel easy-to-conceal [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] for [[Imperial Special Operations|special operations]], a [[Gungan assault cannon]]-based weapon, a new non-lethal [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]], [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] casing units and an airborne anti-fear virus for Imperial troops.<ref name="SWG:QS" /> During that time, the mercenary contingent that protected the facility included [[Kendo Ryzak]], [[Platt Pareja]], [[Goll Bardok]], [[Jeran Tarven]],<ref name="SWG:PtF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Purge the Facility|Lok}}</ref> [[Kell Lapaz]],<ref name="SWG:RT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Research This|Lok}}</ref> and was led by [[Udo Barnet]].<ref name="SWG:QS" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], leader of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and ''de facto'' ruler of Lok, decided to raid the Imperial research facility and steal the weapons developed there.<ref name="SWG:FK" /> Thanks to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Moore]], a corrupted Imperial soldier, the criminals obtained detailed information about the research facility, in particular regarding the new [[Imperial Military Grade Grenade Casing Unit]] (IMGGCU).<ref name="SWG:SwSMA" /> Nym's [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] [[Kole]] thus tasked a group of spacers who had recently joined the Lok Revenants with assaulting the Imperial research facility. The spacers therefore headed to the facility where they fought numerous mercenaries and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] that defended the place.<ref name="SWG:RtrdaI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the research data and IMGGCUs|Lok}}</ref> The Revenants killed several mercenaries, including Kendo Ryzak, Platt Pareja, Goll Bardok, Jeran Tarven,<ref name="SWG:PtF" /> [[Kell Lapaz]] and [[Udo Barnet]].<ref name="SWG:RT" /> In addition, they stole lab data<ref name="SWG:StLD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Steal the Lab Data|Lok}}</ref> and questioned the scientists about the Imperial research projects.<ref name="SWG:QS" /> The Revenants finally found crates of IMGGCU prototypes and brought them back to [[Nym's Base|Nym's fortress]].<ref name="SWG:RtrdaI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Research Facility was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Research Facility was added to the game as part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:NTP" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]]" on [[October 8]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 3: The Warren">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> This questline was later revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
